settings.name: Rosemary
settings.subtitle: Scalp circulation
settings.story:
Benefits: Rosemary is rich in carnosic and rosmarinic acid, natural antioxidants that help boost blood flow to the scalp. Better circulation means follicles get more of what they need — supporting thicker, stronger growth and helping to reduce thinning over time.

In your oil: Blended into your base oil, rosemary gives a fresh, herbal lift. Massage it into the scalp 2–3 times a week to wake up sleepy follicles; it pairs beautifully with Bhringraj for hair fall.

settings.name: Bhringraj
settings.subtitle: Reduces hair fall
settings.story:
Benefits: Called “ruler of hair” in Sanskrit, Bhringraj (Eclipta alba) has been used in Ayurveda for centuries to strengthen roots, reduce hair fall and support new growth. It is naturally cooling and calming for a stressed scalp, and traditionally used to help keep hair dark.

In your oil: Ours is properly heat-infused, so a blend with your base oil carries real concentration. Leave it on overnight once or twice a week as a deep root treatment.

settings.name: Pumpkin Seed
settings.subtitle: Density & thickness
settings.story:
Benefits: Pumpkin seed is full of zinc, magnesium, omega fatty acids and phytosterols — nutrients linked in modern research to reduced thinning and better density. It also helps calm a flaky, itchy scalp and clear the build-up that holds growth back.

In your oil: Blend it into your base oil and massage into the scalp to soothe dandruff and build-up, then smooth the rest through the lengths for fuller-looking hair.

settings.name: Jojoba
settings.subtitle: Lightweight balance
settings.story:
Benefits: Jojoba is technically a liquid wax that closely mirrors your scalp’s own sebum. It absorbs instead of sitting heavy, helps lift product and oil build-up around the follicle, and strengthens the roots and the hair shaft to reduce breakage.

Great for your skin too: Jojoba is one of the most skin-friendly oils there is — it moisturises without clogging pores, softens dry patches and keeps skin balanced. A little of your blend works wonderfully on dry ends, cuticles, elbows and beard.

In your oil: It makes any base oil lighter and less greasy, so it suits oily scalps and daily use.

settings.name: Sweet Almond
settings.subtitle: Shine & softness
settings.story:
Benefits: Sweet almond is rich in Vitamin E, oleic acid and magnesium. It seals in moisture, tames frizz, smooths rough, dry ends and adds a soft natural shine, while helping strands resist breakage.

In your oil: Blend into your base oil and work through mid-lengths and ends for silky, manageable hair; massage into the scalp to ease dryness. Contains tree nut — avoid if you have a nut allergy.

settings.quote: “Nothing on the shelf actually worked — so she made her own.”
settings.heading: It started with a mother,
settings.text:
Kehsora began the way real Ayurvedic hair care always has — at home. A mother formulating her own oil from scratch, using real, purposeful ingredients, because nothing on the shelf actually worked.

That’s still the standard today. We talked to real people before building further — mall interviews that told us the problem was never the ingredients, it was the format. Some people love the ritual of oiling. Others simply don’t have the time. So we built for both: potent concentrates that mix into what you already use, and serums for the days there’s no time to spare.

settings.title: Blend
settings.text: Pour 30ml of concentrate into 150ml of your base oil — coconut, sesame or our Kehsora base oil (50ml into 250ml works too). Same 1 : 5 ratio. Shake well.

settings.title: Warm & part
settings.text: Shake before every use and warm a little of the blend in your palms. Part dry hair into sections.

settings.title: Massage
settings.text: Work the blend into your scalp with your fingertips for 3–5 minutes, then smooth what’s left along the lengths.

settings.title: Leave & wash
settings.text: Leave it on for at least an hour, or overnight. Wash out with a mild shampoo.

settings.title: Repeat
settings.text: Use 2–3 times a week. Most people see a visible difference within 4–6 weeks of regular use.

settings.use_text: Our concentrates are made to be blended into a base oil — that’s what makes them work safely and evenly. Here’s the ritual.
settings.warnings:
• Always blend first. Our concentrates are highly concentrated — never apply them undiluted to the scalp or skin.
  • Patch test a little of your blend behind the ear or on the inner arm 24 hours before first use.
  • For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes — if it happens, rinse well with cool water.
  • Stop using and consult a doctor if redness, itching or irritation appears.
  • Sweet Almond is a tree nut — avoid it if you have a nut allergy.
  • Pregnant or breastfeeding, or under medical care? Check with your doctor first.
  • Not for children under 12 without adult advice. Keep out of reach of children.
  • Store tightly closed in a cool, dark place, away from direct sunlight.
